utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can still help with the repair drive—what’s needed most?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Glad you could make it. We could use help sorting donations first, then loading the truck if you’ve got time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I can start sorting donations right away, and if there’s still time, I’ll help load the truck too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a few tools by the repair drive—just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — could you bring a screwdriver, a wrench set, and some tape? If you have a flashlight too, that would help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring the screwdriver, wrench set, tape, and a flashlight too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep an eye on the supply list for the repair drive. Let me know what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m running late as usual, but I’ll check what tools and paint we still need and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No rush, Dane — just send it when you can and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve only skimmed it, but I think we’re still collecting repair requests and donations. I can check the latest details and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’d appreciate that. Just let me know when you’ve got the latest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help with the repair drive—what details should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s start by checking what items are most urgently needed and whether the drop-off times are set yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the urgent item list and confirm the drop-off times before we move anything forward.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell the others about the repair drive and keep the plans moving.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks Vik. What time should I tell people to show up?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Tell them to show up at 6 PM — I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: we can sort the repair drive into a few clear tasks and do one at a time. Tell me what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds good — first I need to check the school pickup and then I can list the biggest repairs. Let’s start with whatever’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good plan — check the school pickup first, then we’ll tackle the most urgent repair next.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I was just about to ask if you still need a hand with it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please—I’m still trying to sort the pickups and drop-offs, and I’m a bit worried about the timing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course—I can help with the pickups or drop-offs, whichever takes the pressure off most. Just tell me what time you need me, and I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Uli — I’m in for the repair drive. Tell me what you need me to bring or fix.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Mara. If you can help with a wrench set and maybe a little time this weekend, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can bring a wrench set and help this weekend. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m already telling folks about the repair drive, and I can swing by with a quick invite list too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Quinn. I’d appreciate that a lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll put the word out today and bring you a list of who I’ve invited.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive coming up, but I’m still piecing together the details. Have you heard what they need most?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve heard they need tools, a few hands, and maybe some spare parts too. I’ll ask around and repeat the details once I know more.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m mostly hearing bits and pieces, so I’ll wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many repairs are we actually covering in the drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I think we’re covering the most urgent ones first, but I should double-check the list with you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—can you send me the list when you check it? I want to know which repairs are top priority.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive—just tell me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — could you bring some duct tape, a few screwdrivers, and any spare nails you’ve got?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — I’ll grab the duct tape, screwdrivers, and any nails I have.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive list—just tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — that’s a big help. I’ll send you the list of repairs we need and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—send it over when you can, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help however I can. Just let me know what the repair drive needs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — that’s really kind. I’ll send you the list and we can match you to a task that fits.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Rosa. I’ll keep an eye out for the list and pick a task that works for me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive location noted—just point me to where we’re meeting and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—let’s meet at the community center parking lot at 6. I’ll send the full details your way now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ve marked the community center parking lot for 6. Send the rest when you’re ready, and I’ll keep it all straight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I’ve been hearing folks mention the repair drive all morning—sounds like it’s getting some real momentum. What’s the latest with it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—people have been dropping off tools and offering help, and we’re still figuring out a few last details. If you want, I can fill you in on where they need the most support.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great—I’m happy to pass the word along while I’m out. Where do you need the most help?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving, Sam. Let’s line up the jobs and make sure everyone knows where to help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa — I can help sort the jobs and make sure folks know where to go. Let’s get the list organized and keep it simple for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — I’ll jot down the jobs and we can assign a point person for each one. If we keep it clear, the whole block will know exactly where to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Tess — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, wonderful — could you help sort the donated items and keep an eye on the sign-in table? I’ll bring the list and check in with you there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donations and stay at the sign-in table. Just bring the list over when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive time first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll pin down the repair drive time and get it to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — just send it over when you have it and I’ll work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it’s still on. I’ll send the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just wanted to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—want me to check what still needs doing and who’s available?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, please check that and let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check what’s still needed and who’s available, then I’ll get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’ve been a bit out of it; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s still happening, just shifted to the community lot by the library instead of the park entrance.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ah, got it — the community lot by the library. Thanks for catching me up; I’ll head there instead.
